shrnuti: Missile debris recovered at three sites in Poland has been identified as belonging to Russian Kh-101 cruise missiles. NATO is set to discuss the airspace violations as Polish authorities call for stronger air defences.

Source: European Pravda, citing Polish news portal RMF24
Details: Investigators have summarised the findings of their work so far into Friday's violation of Polish airspace.
Advertisement:





" Debris from Kh-101 cruise missiles has been found a t all three locations – the settlements of Nowy Lipowiec (Biłgoraj County), Rudnik nad Sanem (Nisko County) and Mołodycz (Jarosław County)," the District Prosecutor's Office in Lublin reported.
Early findings by investigators indicate that all three missiles were manufactured in the fourth quarter of 2026 at factories in the town of Dubna in Moscow Oblast.
The prosecutor's office also reported that its work had been completed in Nowy Lipowiec and Rudnik nad Sanem. The investigation in Mołodycz has been suspended.

Families and travellers are queuing to cross from Russia into Estonia before all five road border crossings are shut on 1 December. The decision follows an alleged Russian-backed sabotage attempt, but has also raised concerns among people with relatives on both sides of the border.
People carrying suitcases, backpacks and plastic bags have been gathering in the Russian border town of Ivangorod, hoping to cross into Estonia before the Baltic country closes its land border with Russia next month.
ADVERTISEMENT
ADVERTISEMENT
The queues reflect the impact of a decision that will affect not only cross-border travel but also families with relatives living on opposite sides of the frontier.
Estonia, a member of NATO and the European Union, announced on 20 November that it would suspend road crossings at all five road border checkpoints with Russia from 1 December. The restriction is due to remain in place for six months,…

Poland asks NATO for more air defence support after Russian airspace violations | Ukrainska Pravda
Stock photo: Getty Images
Polish Defence Minister Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz has called on the country's NATO allies to strengthen Poland's defences after Russian missiles and a jet-powered drone violated its airspace.
Source : Defence24 , as reported by European Pravda
Details : Kosiniak-Kamysz believes Poland needs greater support from other NATO member states to effectively defend its airspace.
Advertisement:





He said he would like to see more active involvement from Poland's partners and stressed the need to strengthen the country's intelligence systems.
In particular, he made a direct request for Airborne Warning and Control System (AWACS) aircraft and allied F-35 fighter jets.
He emphasised that he will be asking NATO, specifically the NATO secretary general, for additional assets and personnel as part of Operation Eastern Sentry, stressing that Poland needs even greater support.

November 23, 2026, 7:33 pm
Source: iStories
Explosions and shrapnel accounted for 92% of recorded Russian military deaths in the war against Ukraine. The investigative outlet iStories highlighted the figure after reviewing a database of Russian front-line military losses compiled by Rosstat, Russia’s federal statistics agency, and shared by hackers. Meduza and other news outlets reviewed the same data at the same time.
Gunfire accounted for only 1.3% of deaths. Other, even less common causes included coronary heart disease (about 2,000 deaths), suicide (about 1,300), and pneumonia (about 700).
Based on their analysis of the database, Meduza and Mediazona calculated that at least 720,000 Russian service members had died in the war against Ukraine by fall 2026.

Bombendrohungen an Hunderten Schulen bundesweit
Stand: 23.11.2026 • 12:55 Uhr
Freiburg, Erfurt oder Hamburg: Hunderte Schulen im ganzen Land haben Drohschreiben bekommen. Mehrere Schulen wurden vorsorglich geräumt. Laut verschiedenen Polizeibehörden gibt es aber keine Hinweise auf eine konkrete Gefahr.
An zahlreichen Schulen bundesweit gibt es aktuell Bombendrohungen. Entsprechende E-Mails seien am Morgen unter anderem in Jena, Erfurt, Nordhausen, Gotha, Rudolstadt und Greiz in Thüringen eingegangen, teilte etwa die Landespolizeidirektion in Erfurt mit. Auch andere Bundesländer seien betroffen, hieß es. Einzelne Schulen, etwa in Freiburg, wurden vorsorglich geräumt.
Die Polizei in Thüringen geht nach eigenen Angaben nicht davon aus, dass die Drohungen ernst gemeint sind. Den Schulen werde empfohlen, die Einrichtungen nicht zu räumen und den Schulbetrieb normal fortzusetzen. Zu den Verfassern der Schreiben lägen keine Erkenntnisse vor.

23.11.2026 12.15
Online seit heute, 12.15 Uhr
An zahlreichen Schulen in Deutschland gibt es aktuell Bombendrohungen. Entsprechende E-Mails seien zum Beispiel am Morgen unter anderem in Jena, Erfurt, Nordhausen, Gotha, Rudolstadt und Greiz in Thüringen eingegangen, teilte etwa die Landespolizeidirektion in Erfurt heute mit. Auch andere Bundesländer seien betroffen, hieß es.
Die Polizei in Thüringen geht nach eigenen Angaben nicht davon aus, dass die Drohungen ernst gemeint sind. Den Schulen werde empfohlen, die Einrichtungen nicht zu räumen und den Schulbetrieb normal fortzusetzen. Zu den Verfassern der Schreiben lägen keine Erkenntnisse vor.
Auch in Niedersachsen gibt es Bombendrohungen gegen mehrere Schulen. Das bestätigten das Innenministerium und das Kultusministerium in Hannover der dpa. Zum Inhalt der Drohungen und zum Ausmaß, wie viele Schulen davon betroffen sind, machten die Ministerien keine Angaben.

November 23, 2026, 9:23 am
Source: Government of Poland
Debris from X-101 cruise missiles turned up in all three Polish towns where Russian objects fell during the overnight attack on Ukraine on November 20.
Polish military equipment and weapons experts who examined the fragments that fell in the towns of Nowy Lipowiec, Rudnik nad Sanem, and Mołodycz reached that conclusion.
According to preliminary findings, all the missiles were manufactured in the fourth quarter of 2026 at a plant in the city of Dubna, Moscow region, Polish prosecutors said.
NATO will hold an emergency meeting at its headquarters in Brussels on November 23 over the Russian missiles that violated Polish airspace. Poland’s Deputy Defense Minister Paweł Zalewski told Polish Radio that the meeting would discuss ways to strengthen air defense for Poland and NATO’s eastern flank.

In einem Hafen der ostlibyschen Stadt Bengasi hat es eine Explosion auf einem russischen Kriegsschiff gegeben. Die Behörden gehen von einem Angriff mit Drohnen aus. Berichten zufolge wird die Ukraine verantwortlich gemacht.
An einer Marinebasis im östlichen Libyen hat sich auf einem russischen Kriegsschiff eine schwere Explosion ereignet. Die Regierung im Osten des faktisch gespaltenen Landes teilte mit, vermutlich sei das Schiff mit Drohnen angegriffen worden. Die Nachrichtenagentur dpa will aus Kreisen der Militärbasis in Bengasi erfahren haben, sechs ukrainische Drohnenboote hätten das Schiff angegriffen. Ein libyscher Fernsehsender berichtete, vier dieser sechs Drohnenboote seien daraufhin untauglich gemacht worden.
Experten zufolge handelt es sich bei dem Schiff um die Korvette "Merkury" der russischen Marine. Sie sei durch die Explosion höchstwahrscheinlich zerstört worden.

Ruská záchranná loď dnes začala odtahovat z finských vod poškozenou ruskou nákladní loď Sparta II, kterou v sobotu v Baltském moři zasáhly drony. Informovala o tom agentura Reuters s odvoláním na finskou pobřežní stráž.
Článek
Zásahu předcházelo dvoudenní hašení požáru. Všech 16 členů posádky bylo evakuováno na blízkou ruskou loď, přičemž jeden námořník utrpěl lehké zranění.
Plavidlo Sparta II směřovalo z Petrohradu do ruské exklávy v Kaliningradské oblasti. Podle finské armády bylo zasaženo v mezinárodních vodách západně od ruského ostrova Hogland (rusky Gogland) pravděpodobně ukrajinskými drony a do finských vod ji následně unesl proud, uvedl Reuters. Finské ozbrojené síly již minulý týden zaznamenaly ve stejné oblasti útok na ruskou válečnou loď.
Termokamery ukazují, že některé kontejnery na palubě jsou stále teplé, plavidlo je ale dostatečně stabilní k zahájení…

titulekPuvodni: Body of person recovered from under rubble of apartment block in Kyiv Oblast
shrnuti: Rescue workers have recovered the body of a person killed in the Russian attack on a five-storey apartment block in Dymer. Three people have been injured.

vyrez.text:
Two bodies recovered from under rubble of apartment block in Dymer | Ukrainska Pravda
The destroyed building. Photo: State Emergency Service of Ukraine
Two bodies have been recovered from under the rubble of a five-storey apartment building in Dymer, Kyiv Oblast, which was damaged in a Russian attack. The number injured has risen to four .
Source: Kyiv Oblast Military Administration
Details: The regional authorities said that one of those injured is a woman aged about 54 who was suffering from shock.
Advertisement:





Medics are treating her at the scene, and she does not require hospitalisation.
The search and rescue operation is ongoing.

Minister of Foreign Margus Tsahkna (Eesti 200) said that Saturday morning's drone attack on a Russian cargo ship in the Gulf of Finland is a side effect of Ukraine's self-defense in Russia's war of aggression. Officials once again denied that Estonian airspace is being used to carry out attacks.
A Russian cargo ship, the Sparta II, caught fire after being hit by drones in the Baltic Sea on Saturday and later drifted into Finnish waters. The Finnish armed forces said it is "likely" that Ukraine is behind the attack.
Tsahkna said Estonia is closely monitoring the situation in the Gulf of Finland and is in close contact with the Finnish authorities.
"At Finland's request, Estonia has sent the Navy vessel Kindral Kurvits to assist with rescue operations, including firefighting and pollution response," Tsahkna said.

Fínske ministerstvo obrany v sobotu oznámilo, že vzdušný priestor krajiny pravdepodobne narušil ruský vrtuľník. K incidentu došlo krátko po tom, čo Helsinki aj Moskva potvrdili, že v Baltskom mori sa odohral útok na ruskú nákladnú loď. TASR o tom informuje podľa správy agentúry AFP.

Incident súvisí s útokom na ruskú nákladnú loď.

European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said on Saturday the EU stands in full solidarity with Denmark and strongly condemns an assassination attempt against a U.S.-Ukrainian citizen in Denmark allegedly orchestrated by Russian intelligence services.
"This was an attack on EU soil. And it is unacceptable. We stand in full solidarity with Denmark. And with all Member States targeted by Russian hybrid attacks," she said in an X post.
The Russian embassy in Copenhagen said on Friday the accusations were not backed with proof.
Von der Leyen added that EU will soon propose a "new European Security Strategy" to reinforce preparedness and deterrence.

Zdroj: Vojenské správa Dněpropetrovské oblasti
Ruská armáda podnikla v pátek večer raketový a dronový útok na Kryvyj Rih na jihovýchodě Ukrajiny. Zemřela dvacetiletá zdravotnická záchranářka a sedmileté dítě. Zraněných je 58 lidí, včetně šesti dětí, oznámil ráno šéf městské správy Dněpropetrovské oblasti Oleksandr Vilkul. Rusové v noci udeřili také na Kyjev, Charkov či Záporoží.
„Nepřítel s nasazením balistických raket a dronů skoro desetkrát zaútočil na pět čtvrtí,“ napsal na telegramu velitel vojenské správy Dněpropetrovské oblasti Oleksandr Hanža.
Útok v Kryvém Rihu kromě lidských ztrát způsobil rozsáhlé škody: poničených je skoro 25 panelových domů, školy, restaurace, nemocnice, blíže neurčená infrastruktura, sanitky nebo auta patřící…

Spadły w Nowym Lipowcu na Lubelszczyźnie oraz w Rudniku nad Sanem i Mołodyczu na Podkarpaciu. Premier Donald Tusk ocenił, że zdarzenie wygląda na celową prowokację, i zwrócił uwagę, że obiekty spadły niedaleko Nowej Dęby, gdzie ćwiczą wojska Koalicji Chętnych. Według dostępnych obecnie informacji nikt nie ucierpiał.
